text: In 1955 New York, the private investigator Harry Angel is hired by Louis Cyphre to find Johnny Favorite, a crooner who [broke a contract with him|origin|bargains with dark powers]. The trail runs from a hospital with falsified records to New Orleans, to Favorite's old lover's daughter Epiphany, and everyone Harry questions [dies soon after he leaves|wants|claiming souls and victims]. In a hotel room, as [blood seems to drip from the ceiling|images|blood], Harry's search closes in on [a face he already knows|rules|it wears a familiar face].
